canonical_name: TCP Window Scale and Timestamps option family (RFC 7323 generation)
flow_or_congestion_control: Window Scale changes interpretation of the legacy receive-window field; Timestamps support RTT measurement and PAWS.

related_artifacts.notes: Extends the living TCP base protocol without replacing its base header.

notes: A modern SYN often exposes this 1990s-derived high-performance option layer beside the older TCP core.
